requirement_text.REQ-393: Generic, tenant-agnostic entity-list browse screen with filter builder, sort control, and page-size control wired to POST /entities/query. WHAT EXISTS TODAY: EntityCrudPage.tsx (REQ-343) is BilimBaga-only, uses compile-time EXCLUDE_DELETED_FILTERS, client-side sort only (no sort clause to server), hardcoded PAGE_SIZE=25 constant. WHAT IS NEEDED: A generic entity-list screen (new component or extended EntityCrudPage) that: (1) renders a filter builder (field/operator/value rows, driven by EntityDefinition queried:true fields, submitted as filters array); (2) renders a sort control (field+direction) sent as sort array to POST /entities/query, disabling client-side sort; (3) renders a page-size control surfacing :page_size_too_large 400 as readable message; (4) surfaces :field_not_allowed 422 as readable message naming the specific field; (5) writes real Playwright spec at web/tests/e2e/pipelines/entity-list-query.pipeline.e2e.spec.ts covering filter, sort-then-page, non-searchable-filter rejection, over-limit-page-size rejection. OUT OF SCOPE: Vortex provisioning, REQ-394 entity-type authorization, BilimBaga regression. AC: filter builder exists and drives POST query; sort control sends server-side sort verified across 2+ pages; page-size control shows readable error; field_not_allowed rejection shows readable message; Playwright spec passes against running instance; BilimBaga not regressed; compile/test/lint all pass.
